_approach: The Latin percussion loop from `techno_perc_01` stripped down to a breakdown: no kick at all, just the shaker bed, congas and clave carrying the groove alone, with the clave thinned to once per bar in bar 2. This is the percussive-techno equivalent of the 'perc loop only' breakdown — space for the low end to drop out while the groove keeps its identity. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
